title: Quell the Herd
summary: Animalism 6: smothering the Beasts of a crowd.

claims.text: Like Quell the Beast but on many targets at once: animals or people who can see or hear the Gangrel lose passion and will and turn listless for the duration.
The roll is Strength + Intimidation at difficulty 7.

title: Stampede
summary: Animalism 7: turning a crowd to panic.

claims.text: The Gangrel sparks a blind panic that sends hundreds into flight; it works only on large groups that some ordinary cause has already stirred up, such as a predator's scent or a lost home game.
It needs a crowd of roughly fifty agitated mortals in sight.

title: Eyes of the Forest
summary: Animalism 9: becoming one with a domain.

claims.text: The vampire sinks into the ground of a chosen domain and spreads through it; unlike Earth Meld the Gangrel cannot simply be dug out, and every animal and insect there serves as eyes and ears.
It costs six blood points and lasts as long as the Gangrel wishes; tales of brooding forests and forbidding mountains grow from it.

title: Sensory Shield
summary: Fortitude 6: senses that cannot be overwhelmed.

claims.text: For two blood points over a scene, spotlights, muzzle flash, explosions and pepper spray cannot blind or deafen the Gangrel, and pain is easier to bear.
While it lasts, the vampire's eyes, ears, nose and open wounds give off an eerie glow.

title: Resilient Mind
summary: Fortitude 7: a mind hardened against intrusion.

claims.text: On learning it, the Gangrel may shed centuries of tics and paranoia, and mental Disciplines grow harder to use against the vampire.
The price is that from then on any animal flaws the vampire gains must be physical ones; a Willpower roll at difficulty 7 is made on learning it.

title: Shape of the Beast, Gangrel Version

claims.text: Only for Clan Gangrel: the vampire picks one fight form and one flight form when learning the power, and they can never change.
The Gangrel keeps personality, memories and skills and gains the animal's natural abilities; one blood point assumes either form.

title: Animal Swarm
summary: Protean 7: dissolving into many small creatures.

claims.text: The Gangrel breaks into a swarm of rats, crows, scorpions or the like, steering them together or one by one, and can reform from any or all of them.
Each creature carries one blood point, up to the vampire's current pool; blood in creatures that do not rejoin is lost.

title: Mythic Form
summary: Protean 8: taking the shape of a legend.

claims.text: The Gangrel becomes a beast of myth drawn from personal tradition, such as a griffin for an ancient Scythian, a sphinx for an Egyptian or a thunderbird for a Native American, with the powers legend gives it.
It costs three blood points to begin the change.
